cards.example_en: Sports day can promote teamwork among the younger students.
cards.example_zh: 运动会能促进低年级学生之间的团队合作。

cards.example_en: Lily will propose a picnic if Saturday stays sunny.
cards.example_zh: 如果星期六一直晴朗，莉莉会提议去野餐。

cards.example_en: These results prove that regular sleep helps exam scores.
cards.example_zh: 这些结果证明规律睡眠有助于考试成绩。

cards.example_en: The hotel will provide breakfast for the visiting team.
cards.example_zh: 酒店将为来访的队伍提供早餐。

cards.example_en: A local publisher will publish the class history book.
cards.example_zh: 一家当地出版社将出版这本班级史书。

cards.example_en: Don't pull the curtain so hard or it will tear.
cards.example_zh: 别那么用力拉窗帘，不然会扯破。

cards.example_en: We purchase fruit from the market before the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 野餐前我们从市场购买水果。

cards.example_en: You should push the door, not pull the handle.
cards.example_zh: 你应该推这扇门，而不是拉门把手。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：放；放置
cards.example_en: Put the milk back in the fridge after breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭后把牛奶放回冰箱。

cards.example_en: We usually reach the stadium before the match starts.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常在比赛开始前到达体育场。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：读；阅读
cards.example_en: I read the bus timetable while I wait outside.
cards.example_zh: 我在外面等车时读公交时刻表。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：准备好的
cards.example_en: Are you ready for the spelling test this afternoon?
cards.example_zh: 你准备好今天下午的拼写测验了吗？

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：意识到
cards.example_en: I didn't realise the library closes early on Wednesday.
cards.example_zh: 我没有意识到图书馆星期三提早关门。

cards.example_en: We should replace the cracked window before winter.
cards.example_zh: 入冬之前我们应该换掉那扇裂了的窗户。

cards.example_en: A short rest on the bench soon cooled us down.
cards.example_zh: 在长椅上稍作休息后，我们很快凉快了下来。
